title: Batched restricted Fourier observation program
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, let $S\subseteq J$, and let $m\in\mathbb N$. Given three lists of $m$ sign vectors, the membership-query program processes them position by position as follows: it uses the first vector's coordinates outside $J$ and the second and third vectors' coordinates on $J$ to form two inputs, queries the target at both, and records the resulting rational restricted Fourier weight observation, charging $2n+2|S|+1$ local steps for each position. It returns the list of the $m$ observations in their original order.
hypotheses_covered: three input functions each provide $m$ sign vectors
